name: Function conformance
description: Worked inputs for every FormCel function, recalculated live, each result checked against the result its function page states.

sheets.name: Summary
rows: The example inputs and formulas for the functions FormCel computes, with the result each function page states: data at A1, each formula in column AA, the stated result in AB, and a match test in AC. The pages, linked in column F, were read 2026-10-21; their explanations are not copied here.
Cases not compared say why in column AD of their sheet.

sheets.name: CONCAT
rows: =CONCAT("Stream population for ", A2," ", A3, " is ", A4, "/mile.")
Stream population for brook trout species is 32/mile.
